description: Commissioner of Elections - Appointed Mr. Ahamadulebbe Mohamadu Nazeer  as a  member of the Eighth Parliament
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy under the Parliamentary Elections Act. It contains details about a resignation from parliament, nomination of a replacement by a political party, and the formal declaration of a new Member of Parliament by the Election Commission. The content focuses entirely on electoral processes and parliamentary membership matters, which aligns with the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) covering candidate nominations, registrations, and election-related declarations.
